definition: to stop doing something, especially something bad or annoying (quit + -ing)
translation: bỏ làm gì, ngừng làm gì
exampleSentence: He has six months to live if he doesn't quit drinking.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy chỉ còn sống được sáu tháng nếu không bỏ rượu.

definition: to remember something that happened in the past (recall + -ing)
exampleSentence: I don't recall seeing any cars parked outside.
exampleTranslation: Tôi không nhớ đã thấy chiếc xe nào đỗ bên ngoài.

definition: to advise doing something, especially because you have special knowledge; you cannot say "recommend somebody to do" (recommend + -ing)
exampleSentence: I would never recommend using a sunbed on a regular basis.
exampleTranslation: Tôi sẽ không bao giờ khuyên dùng giường tắm nắng thường xuyên.

definition: to tell people about something you saw or know happened, as a witness or in the news (report + -ing)
translation: cho biết đã thấy ai làm gì
exampleSentence: Witnesses reported seeing three people flee the scene.
exampleTranslation: Các nhân chứng cho biết đã thấy ba người bỏ chạy khỏi hiện trường.

definition: to feel angry or upset about something that has happened to you (resent + -ing)
translation: bực bội vì phải làm gì
exampleSentence: I resented having to work such long hours.
exampleTranslation: Tôi bực bội vì phải làm việc nhiều giờ như vậy.

definition: to try to prevent a change, or to stop yourself being forced to do something (resist + -ing)
translation: chống lại việc làm gì, cưỡng lại việc làm gì
exampleSentence: For months the company has resisted changing its accounts system.
exampleTranslation: Suốt nhiều tháng công ty đã chống lại việc thay đổi hệ thống kế toán.

definition: to get into a situation where something unpleasant may happen to you (risk + -ing)
translation: liều làm gì, có nguy cơ làm gì
exampleSentence: They may even risk losing their homes.
exampleTranslation: Họ thậm chí có thể liều mất nhà.

definition: to tell someone your idea about what to do (suggest + -ing)
translation: gợi ý làm gì, đề nghị làm gì
exampleSentence: Tracey suggested meeting for a drink after work.
exampleTranslation: Tracey gợi ý gặp nhau uống nước sau giờ làm.

definition: to feel anxious about something that is going to happen (dread + -ing)
exampleSentence: I'm dreading going back to work.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đang sợ phải đi làm trở lại.

definition: to involve something as a necessary part or result; formal (entail + -ing)
translation: đòi hỏi phải làm gì, kéo theo việc làm gì
exampleSentence: The journey will entail changing trains twice.
exampleTranslation: Chuyến đi sẽ đòi hỏi phải đổi tàu hai lần.

definition: to use time doing a particular thing (spend + time + -ing)
exampleSentence: Stacey spends all her free time painting.
exampleTranslation: Stacey dành toàn bộ thời gian rảnh để vẽ.

definition: used to say that someone should do something because they will gain something from it (be worth + -ing)
exampleSentence: It's worth checking the details of the contract before you sign it.
exampleTranslation: Nên kiểm tra kỹ các chi tiết của hợp đồng trước khi ký.

definition: to start doing something; the meaning is the same as begin + -ing (begin + to-infinitive)
exampleSentence: She began to feel a sense of panic.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy bắt đầu cảm thấy hoảng sợ.

definition: to start doing something; the meaning is the same as begin + to-infinitive (begin + -ing)
exampleSentence: I began teaching in 1984.
exampleTranslation: Tôi bắt đầu đi dạy vào năm 1984.

definition: to do something you were not doing before and continue doing it; the meaning is the same as start + -ing (start + to-infinitive)
exampleSentence: It's starting to rain.
exampleTranslation: Trời bắt đầu mưa rồi.

definition: to do something you were not doing before and continue doing it; the meaning is the same as start + to-infinitive (start + -ing)
exampleSentence: Then the baby started crying.
exampleTranslation: Rồi em bé bắt đầu khóc.

definition: to not stop doing something (continue + to-infinitive)
exampleSentence: Sheila continued to work after she had her baby.
exampleTranslation: Sheila tiếp tục đi làm sau khi sinh em bé.

definition: to not stop doing something (continue + -ing)
exampleSentence: Most elderly people want to continue living at home for as long as they can.
exampleTranslation: Hầu hết người cao tuổi muốn tiếp tục sống ở nhà chừng nào còn có thể.

definition: to enjoy something, or to think it is a good thing to do (like + to-infinitive)
exampleSentence: I like to see people enjoying themselves.
exampleTranslation: Tôi thích thấy mọi người vui vẻ.

definition: to enjoy doing something (like + -ing)
exampleSentence: I don't like talking in public.
exampleTranslation: Tôi không thích nói chuyện trước đám đông.

definition: to like something very much (love + to-infinitive)
exampleSentence: We all love to talk about ourselves.
exampleTranslation: Ai trong chúng ta cũng thích nói về bản thân.

definition: to enjoy doing something very much (love + -ing)
exampleSentence: I love going out to restaurants.
exampleTranslation: Tôi rất thích đi ăn nhà hàng.

definition: to dislike something very much (hate + to-infinitive)
translation: ghét làm gì, không muốn làm gì
exampleSentence: I hate to see you unhappy.
exampleTranslation: Tôi không muốn thấy bạn buồn.

definition: to dislike doing something very much (hate + -ing)
exampleSentence: Paul hates having his picture taken.
exampleTranslation: Paul ghét bị chụp ảnh.

definition: to like one thing more than another, so you choose to do it (prefer + to-infinitive)
exampleSentence: I prefer to wear clothes made of natural fibers.
exampleTranslation: Tôi thích mặc quần áo làm từ sợi tự nhiên hơn.

definition: to like doing one thing more than another (prefer + -ing)
exampleSentence: Chantal prefers travelling by train.
exampleTranslation: Chantal thích đi bằng tàu hơn.

definition: to pause in what you are doing in order to do something else (stop + to-infinitive)
exampleSentence: I stopped to tie my shoe.
exampleTranslation: Tôi dừng lại để buộc dây giày.

definition: to not continue doing something (stop + -ing)
exampleSentence: I stopped digging and looked at him.
exampleTranslation: Tôi ngừng đào và nhìn anh ta.

definition: to not forget something that you must do, get or bring (remember + to-infinitive)
exampleSentence: Remember to take your PE clothes to school.
exampleTranslation: Nhớ mang đồ thể dục đến trường nhé.

definition: to have a picture or idea in your mind of something you did in the past (remember + -ing)
translation: nhớ đã làm gì (việc đã xảy ra)
exampleSentence: I remember meeting her at a party once.
exampleTranslation: Tôi nhớ đã gặp cô ấy ở một bữa tiệc một lần.

definition: to not remember to do something that you should do (forget + to-infinitive)
exampleSentence: Someone has forgotten to turn off their headlights.
exampleTranslation: Ai đó đã quên tắt đèn pha.

definition: to take action in order to do something that you may not be able to do (try + to-infinitive)
exampleSentence: He tried to control his voice.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy cố kiềm chế giọng nói của mình.

definition: to do something for a short time to find out if it works or is suitable (try + -ing)
exampleSentence: They decided to try living in America for a while.
exampleTranslation: Họ quyết định thử sống ở Mỹ một thời gian.

definition: used in official letters to say you are sorry about something you are about to say (regret + to-infinitive)
translation: rất tiếc phải làm gì (thông báo)
exampleSentence: I regret to inform you that your contract will not be renewed.
exampleTranslation: Tôi rất tiếc phải thông báo rằng hợp đồng của bạn sẽ không được gia hạn.

definition: to feel sorry about something you did and wish you had not done it (regret + -ing)
translation: hối hận vì đã làm gì
exampleSentence: I regret leaving school so young.
exampleTranslation: Tôi hối hận vì đã bỏ học quá sớm.

definition: to do something after you have finished doing something else (go on + to-infinitive)
translation: tiếp đó làm gì, sau đó làm gì
exampleSentence: She went on to become a successful surgeon.
exampleTranslation: Sau đó cô ấy trở thành một bác sĩ phẫu thuật thành công.

definition: to continue doing something (go on + -ing)
exampleSentence: He went on working until he was 91.
exampleTranslation: Ông ấy tiếp tục làm việc cho đến năm 91 tuổi.

definition: to tell someone what you think they should do, especially when you know more than they do (advise + somebody + to-infinitive)
exampleSentence: Evans advised him to leave London.
exampleTranslation: Evans khuyên anh ta rời London.

definition: to let someone do something (allow + somebody + to-infinitive)
exampleSentence: My parents wouldn't allow me to go to the party.
exampleTranslation: Bố mẹ tôi không cho phép tôi đi dự tiệc.

definition: to make a request to someone to do something (ask + somebody + to-infinitive)
translation: nhờ ai làm gì, yêu cầu ai làm gì
exampleSentence: Ask John to mail those letters tomorrow.
exampleTranslation: Nhờ John gửi những lá thư đó vào ngày mai nhé.

definition: to ask someone for something in an anxious or urgent way because you want it very much (beg + somebody + to-infinitive)
exampleSentence: I begged Helen to stay, but she wouldn't listen.
exampleTranslation: Tôi van nài Helen ở lại, nhưng cô ấy không nghe.

definition: to make something happen to someone, so that they do something (cause + somebody + to-infinitive)
exampleSentence: What caused you to change your mind?
exampleTranslation: Điều gì khiến bạn đổi ý?

definition: to invite someone to prove they can do something, or to dare them to do it (challenge + somebody + to-infinitive)
exampleSentence: I challenge Dr. Carver to deny his involvement!
exampleTranslation: Tôi thách tiến sĩ Carver chối bỏ việc ông ta có liên quan!

definition: to tell someone officially to do something, especially as a military leader (command + somebody + to-infinitive)
translation: ra lệnh cho ai làm gì
exampleSentence: The captain commanded the crew to report to the main deck.
exampleTranslation: Thuyền trưởng ra lệnh cho thủy thủ đoàn tập trung ở boong chính.

definition: to force someone to do something (compel + somebody + to-infinitive)
exampleSentence: The law will compel employers to provide health insurance.
exampleTranslation: Luật sẽ buộc các chủ doanh nghiệp phải cung cấp bảo hiểm y tế.

definition: to persuade someone to do something (convince + somebody + to-infinitive)
exampleSentence: I've been trying to convince Jean to come with me.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đang cố thuyết phục Jean đi cùng tôi.

definition: to make it possible for someone to do something (enable + somebody + to-infinitive)
translation: giúp ai có thể làm gì
exampleSentence: The loan enabled Jan to buy the house.
exampleTranslation: Khoản vay giúp Jan mua được căn nhà.

definition: to give someone the courage or confidence to do something (encourage + somebody + to-infinitive)
exampleSentence: His father encouraged him to begin playing the guitar.
exampleTranslation: Bố anh ấy khuyến khích anh bắt đầu chơi guitar.

definition: to tell someone they are not allowed to do something (forbid + somebody + to-infinitive)
exampleSentence: He was forbidden to leave the house as a punishment.
exampleTranslation: Anh ta bị cấm ra khỏi nhà để làm hình phạt.

definition: to make someone do something they do not want to do (force + somebody + to-infinitive)
exampleSentence: Government troops have forced the rebels to surrender.
exampleTranslation: Quân đội chính phủ đã buộc quân nổi dậy đầu hàng.
